_about: Curator rulings on college/district identity. Judgements live HERE, as data, so a crosswalk rebuild can never overwrite one — the same reason cr_reference_decisions is a table rather than a derived value. Every ruling carries WHO and WHEN, because a curator's knowledge is a first-class input and must be attributed, not laundered into an anonymous value.

_schema.same_entity: A spelling that IS an existing identity. Folded into that row's variants.
_schema.separate_entity: A genuinely distinct MAP org that shares a stem with a known one. NOT folded. If map_college_id is null, MAP's own id for it is unknown to us and must be supplied — never minted here, because college_id is MAP's to assign.

rulings.source: Direct instruction in session: "Calbright and LAUNCH get 2 entities--one credit, one noncredit. San Diego and North Orange are one entity"
rulings.question: Four names ending in 'Credit' or 'Non-Credit' sit beside a known identity. Two MAP orgs each, or one org spelled twice?
